name: Camp Welch
operator_name: Boys & Girls Club of Fall River
description_short: Camp Welch is the Boys & Girls Club of Fall River's summer program for ages 5–12. It sits on 165 wooded acres with 20 camp buildings, ball fields and two swimming pools. Activities include team sports, swimming lessons, arts and crafts, and hiking.
swim_waterfront_notes: Two swimming pools on site; swimming lessons and pool recreation offered.
